name: QiYi Mosaic 3x3 Cube Set of 100 (10x10 2.8cm Cubes)
description: The QiYi Mosaic 3x3 Cube Set of 100 (10x10, 2.8cm cubes) is the ultimate fusion of cubing and creativity. This innovative set features 100 mini black plastic 3x3 cubes, each measuring 2.8cm, perfectly arranged in a sleek 10x10 grid. The included ornate backboard is not only visually striking, but also versatile— tilt it to your preferred angle or display your mosaic masterpiece on the wall with ease.
